rules.textSv: Majoriteten av kurserna som erbjuds under termin 1 erbjuds även under termin 3. Studenterna förväntas dela upp belastningen mellan dessa två terminer.
rules.labelEn: Most semester 1 courses are also offered in semester 3, and students are expected to spread their workload across these two semesters.
